# `mise bootstrap packages cleanup`

- **Usage**: `mise bootstrap packages cleanup [FLAGS]`
- **Source code**: [`src/cli/bootstrap/packages/cleanup.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap/packages/cleanup.rs)

Uninstall unneeded system packages

Removes packages that are no longer requested in `[bootstrap.packages]` and
are not dependencies of the remaining requested packages. Managers only run
cleanup when mise has reliable ownership and dependency data for that
package manager.

## Flags

### `-m --manager <MANAGER>`

Only cleanup packages for this manager, e.g. `brew`

**Choices:**

- `apk`
- `apt`
- `brew`
- `brew-cask`
- `dnf`
- `mas`
- `pacman`

### `-n --dry-run`

Print the packages that would be removed without removing them

### `-y --yes`

Skip the confirmation prompt

Examples:

```
mise bootstrap packages cleanup
mise bootstrap packages cleanup --manager brew
mise bootstrap packages cleanup --dry-run
```
